summary: Iteration 10 verification of black-screen fix (normalizeBackendUrl + ErrorBoundary + Array.isArray guards). Backend smoke all green (5/5 pytest). normalizeBackendUrl JS unit tests all 9/9 cases pass including 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://x.com' -> 'https://x.com', trailing slash stripped, empty/undefined -> '', non-URL passthrough. Frontend on Emergent preview at 390x844: Home renders home-page testid (no black screen), 6 service cards in 3-col grid, hero + floating buttons visible; /reservar renders booking-page with 6 pick-service items in step 1; /admin/login renders. Zero console errors. ErrorBoundary component correctly not shown in happy path but wired as outermost wrapper in App.js around AuthProvider+BrowserRouter+Toaster with data-testid=error-boundary and reload-btn.
action_items: Reminder for the user (out of code scope): on Railway, set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to only the URL (no 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=' prefix). Sanitizer is a safety net but a clean env var is preferred.
critical_code_review_comments: normalizeBackendUrl regex /https?:\/\/[^\s"']+/i is correct and covers the reported malformation.
ErrorBoundary is placed as outermost wrapper in App.js so it also protects Router/AuthProvider throw paths - good.
Home.jsx and Booking.jsx both guard services with Array.isArray and Booking guards slots with Array.isArray(r.data?.slots).
Minor: r.data?.slots optional chaining assumes availability returns { slots: [...] } - matches backend contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 shipped a URL sanitizer + ErrorBoundary safety net for the Railway black-screen bug. Preview env has a valid REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL so ErrorBoundary is not triggered in production preview. To manually test the fallback UI, temporarily throw in a page component or navigate with an intentional runtime error. Backend endpoints /api/, /api/business, /api/services, /api/auth/login all green.
